fib.workload: Recursive fib(40), one process invocation; same recurrence in Turbo/Rust.

wordcount.workload: Existing 5MiB seeded ASCII corpus, word frequencies, top20 count-desc/lexical ties.
wordcount.oracle: Independent Python Counter and ordered top20 plus total/unique.
wordcount.comparison_caveat: Idiomatic end-to-end comparison, NOT identical implementation: Turbo selects top20 by repeated scan; Rust sorts all counts; token/storage paths also differ.

json_transform.workload: Seeded records with strings/control/Unicode, numbers and bools; parse/filter/project/serialize.
json_transform.oracle: Parsed records equal an independent semantic oracle; bytes counted; freeze dataset before implementation.

string_tokens.workload: Fixed ASCII and Unicode token corpus with explicit normalization rules.
string_tokens.oracle: Exact token/count sequence and digest; freeze corpus before optimization.

hashmap_churn.oracle: Reference dictionary results plus final digest; fixed live working set.

buffer_scan.workload: At least32MiB deterministic byte data, checksummed scanning and mutation.
buffer_scan.oracle: Independent byte checksum and exact final selected positions.

particle_update.workload: 10k seeded particles with fixed-step update count and layout profile.
particle_update.oracle: Reference trajectory digest/tolerance with fixed floating-point policy.

tree_walk.workload: Seeded acyclic allocation-heavy tree, deterministic traversal/drop.
tree_walk.oracle: Reference traversal result and balanced allocation accounting.

sqlite.workload: Seeded database, transactional batch insert and ordered query workload.
sqlite.oracle: Exact rows/transaction outcomes with matching SQLite configuration.

http_compute.workload: Fixed compute request bodies at declared rate/concurrency.
http_compute.oracle: Response oracle and error counts; measure latency separately.

worker.workload: Fixed job set and documented retries/recovery schedule.
worker.oracle: Durable state/effect oracle; no acknowledged loss.
worker.prerequisite: G5 worker kit and fault harness
